summary: Contabilidad por partida doble para una empresa pequeña: plan de cuentas, asientos equilibrados, balance de comprobación, BALANCE y ESTADO DE RESULTADOS, con asientos sencillos («cobré», «pagué», «facturé») para quien no sabe contabilidad.
dataClassification: confidential-financial (the host stores the journal; the module stores nothing)
invariants: Imports nothing. Amounts are integers in minor units (cents); floats are rejected.
An entry only exists if debit = credit, with one currency and known, non-archived accounts.
The journal is append-only: corrections are reversal entries (reverseEntry); a reversal cannot be reversed.
The balance sheet always reports Assets − (Liabilities + Equity) and `balanced`.
Every report states how many entries lack a supporting document (`evidence.unverifiedEntries`).
No company data inside: chart, journal and currency are host inputs.
api: createAccount · createJournalEntry · reverseEntry · quickLines · splitVat · parseAmountToMinor · accountBalances · trialBalance · incomeStatement({from,to,currency}) · balanceSheet({asOf,currency}) · journalCsv · currenciesIn · DEFAULT_CHART · QUICK_LABELS

mounts.product: JANUS · administración de la empresa (solo Founder)

plannedMounts: Infinity Business Assistant (IBA): contabilidad por cliente
reuseNotes: Persist the validated JournalEntry objects anywhere (they are plain JSON) and pass them back with the chart to the report functions. Replace DEFAULT_CHART with a country chart (PGC, RGS…) without touching the logic: reports group by `group`, not by code.
knownLimits: No multi-currency consolidation: one report per currency.
No inventory, payroll, accruals automation or depreciation schedules (they can be posted as manual entries).
Figures are only as good as the entries: it does not read bank feeds by itself.
Not a statutory annual-accounts generator and not tax advice.
